title: Generalize VcsHistory/ProtocolList Surfaces to GraphTimeline/BlockList
description: Rename the app-named SurfaceKind variants VcsHistory -> GraphTimeline (wire "vcs-history" -> "graph-timeline") and ProtocolList -> BlockList (wire "protocol-list" -> "block-list") across ui/wgpu/rs/lib.rs, framework/core/js/index.ts, framework/renderer/react/ui-interpreter.tsx (+ host component file rename), framework/renderer/wgpu/rs/lib.rs, and fix all call sites across the repo (including owning app's plugin crate and any shared files touched minimally). Rename scene structs VcsHistoryScene/HistoryColumn and ProtocolListScene/ProtocolPaletteEntry->BlockPaletteEntry accordingly. Part of the SurfaceKind framework-purity generalization series (sequential stage, shared files may already have prior renames from earlier stages). Parent ticket not yet materialized at ticket_open time (see GENERALIZE-APPS-ONTO-FRAMEWORK-PRIMITIVES).
